source_files.role: Current companion proof manuscript; Article Theorems 1 and 2 are formalized
Current companion Letter; equation-level correspondence and geometric scope recorded below

scope: Source inventory and correspondence, not a claim to formalize the whole Letter. Status consequence-of-article means specialization of an existing checked Article statement; definition-correspondence records shared definitions; not-formalized means no Lean certificate for that Letter claim.
locator_policy: TeX labels and fully qualified Lean declarations are primary. One-based line numbers are navigation hints for the current source snapshot and can shift after edits.

entries.title: Full-rank known-spectrum QMDL
entries.summary: Achievability with the exact additive constant, and a liminf converse for every vanishing-error sequence, specialize the Article endpoints to r=d. This entry does not certify a physical-free-entropy identity.

entries.title: Rank-deficient known-spectrum QMDL
entries.summary: The Article endpoints cover every positive rank with distinct positive eigenvalues and a zero block. The pure-state memory formula follows by r=1, p1=1. General repeated positive eigenvalues are not covered.

entries.title: Global reconstruction-error criterion
entries.summary: Same worst-case half-trace-norm criterion and actual physical tensor source as the Article definitions. The Letter does not require preserving a purification.

entries.title: Dimension of the retained representation
entries.summary: The full-rank Weyl dimension asymptotic follows from the actual dimension and padded-target expansion proved in the Article development. Its KKS interpretation is a separate geometric explanation.

entries.title: Physical free entropy and regularized spectral term
entries.summary: Defines an unnormalized ambient Hilbert-Schmidt tube-volume ratio, with coinciding eigenvalues excluded from the logarithmic-gap sum. Covering-number entropy agrees only up to O(1); the current Lean endpoint definitions do not include this volume ratio.

entries.title: Hilbert-Schmidt Jacobian and full-rank tube expansion
entries.summary: The Letter derives the exact (2 pi) Jacobian, gamma/factorial constant and O_d(epsilon^2/g^2) remainder. These geometric calculations have not been formalized in this repository.

entries.title: Half-physical-entropy identity and spectrum-independent offset
entries.summary: The attaining memory is one half of chi_phy at resolution n^-1 plus the explicit C_{d,r} and o(1). Article certificates establish the memory formula; the additional volume comparison and C_{d,r} identity are not separately Lean certified.

entries.title: General-multiplicity tube volume
entries.summary: The Letter derives a geometric entropy expansion for arbitrary spectral multiplicities. This does not prove QMDL optimality for repeated positive eigenvalues, which remains conjectural, and neither geometric expansion is currently a Lean certificate.

entries.title: Conditional large-dimension bridge to Voiculescu entropy
entries.summary: A manuscript derivation under compact support, finite logarithmic energy, separated quantile discretizations with convergent discrete energies, epsilon_d=o(g_d), and log(epsilon_d^-1)=o(d). These assumptions and the double-scaling claim are not covered by the current finite-dimensional Lean endpoints.
